description: FREE. The US IPO pipeline: operating companies that have filed with the SEC but are not trading yet (status upcoming), or deals that were withdrawn or postponed. Each row has company, ticker when assigned, CIK, exchange, expected trading date when one is scheduled, the date of the latest status change, price range, shares offered, Nasdaq's deal size, and a link to the latest SEC filing. Status is the one the iposignal.xyz calendar shows, so SPACs and other vehicles are excluded. Use it to see what is coming to market or what was pulled; follow up with get_ipo_filings for one company's filing history or get_ipo_snapshot for the full deal profile. Arguments: status (upcoming, withdrawn or postponed; default upcoming), since as YYYY-MM-DD for withdrawn/postponed (default one year ago), limit (default 100, max 500). Upcoming deals sort by expected date, undated last.

limit.description: Maximum deals to return, 1-500. Defaults to 100.

since.description: Withdrawn/postponed only: earliest status date to include, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to one year ago.

status.description: upcoming (filed, not trading yet), withdrawn, or postponed. Defaults to upcoming.

name: get_ipo_pipeline

expectedDate.description: Next expected trading date, YYYY-MM-DD (upcoming deals that carry one).

form.description: SEC form type, e.g. S-1, S-1/A, F-1, EFFECT, 424B4, RW.

latestFiling.description: The newest SEC filing we hold for the company.

offerAmountUsd.description: Deal size in USD, as Nasdaq states it.

priceRange.description: Price range as the exchange or IPOScoop states it.

statusDate.description: Date of the latest status change, YYYY-MM-DD.

symbol.description: Ticker, when one has been assigned.

deals.description: Deals: upcoming by expected date, others newest first.

since.description: For withdrawn/postponed: earliest status date included, YYYY-MM-DD. Null for upcoming.

title: IPO pipeline (free)
